source: Caches and memory interfaces do not generally move one arbitrary scalar from ZXNAME0000XZ for every source-level load. They transfer aligned sectors or larger blocks. Current Nsight documentation, for example, reports 32-byte sectors in L1 and L2, while L2 requests may cover up to four sectors from a 128-byte cache line.[3]
zh: 对于每个源级加载，高速缓存和内存接口通常不会从 ZXNAME0000XZ 移动一个任意标量。它们传输对齐的扇区或更大的块。例如，当前的 Nsight 文档报告了 L1 和 L2 中的 32 字节扇区，而 L2 请求可能覆盖 128 字节缓存行中的最多四个扇区。 [3]
